value.title: Villersexel
value.extract: Villersexel (French pronunciation: [vilɛʁsɛksɛl] ) is a commune in the Haute-Saône department in the region of Bourgogne-Franche-Comté in eastern France. The current population is about 1,400 residents (2022). The town center includes several restaurants, a school, a church and the Château de Villersexel.
